answer: In PoA, each node’s reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence requires sustained, honestly reciprocated service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming paths; whether named zephyr, nebula, or raven, they cannot acquire enough weighted support to pass consensus before their scores decay.
